Two side items remain unresolved and EXCLUDED pending confirmation. Working model: 110 g dry ramen equivalent (USDA 171177: 484 kcal, P11.22 C66.33 F19.36), 170 g braised chuck eye with fat (USDA 173099: 428.4 kcal, P50.83 C0 F24.99), about 9 g additional broth fat (81 kcal), and roughly 10 kcal onion/cilantro/chile (about 2 g carbs).
